entities.name: iHeartVIP Revival Initiative
entities.description: A project to revive the iHeartVIP.com domain as a modern fan engagement hub powered by Genuin, transforming it from a 2019 music/industry news site into a video and community platform.

entities.name: iHeartVIP
entities.description: The destination platform being revived as a high-engagement video and community hub, supporting event discovery, communities, contests, and fan experiences.

entities.name: iHeartVIP.com Domain
entities.description: The domain to be white-labeled with a Genuin-powered subdomain to deliver the iHeartVIP experience.

entities.name: Genuin Web Platform
entities.description: The existing Genuin web infrastructure that will power the white-labeled iHeartVIP experience in the backend.

entities.name: Genuin Video and Community Infrastructure
entities.description: Genuin's core infrastructure enabling video clips, creator uploads, discussions, event content hubs, and brand activations that will power iHeartVIP.

entities.name: BCC
entities.description: Genuin's brand management system inside which iHeart's brand instances are configured and subdomains are managed.

entities.name: iHeart Brand Instance on BCC
entities.description: The existing iHeart production brand inside BCC, currently served at iheartmedia.begenuin.com, considered for reuse under Approach 1.

entities.name: iHeartVIP Brand Instance on BCC
entities.description: A proposed new brand inside BCC dedicated to iHeartVIP under Approach 2, served at iheartvip.begenuin.com.

entities.name: Event Communities
entities.description: Communities organized around each iHeart event, supporting video clips, creator uploads, discussions, content hubs, and brand activations on iHeartVIP.

entities.name: Podcast Communities
entities.description: Communities on iHeartVIP organized around podcasts as part of the platform structure.

entities.name: Artist Communities
entities.description: Communities on iHeartVIP organized around artists.

entities.name: Contests and Fan Experiences
entities.description: Integrated contests, giveaways, and fan experience features available on iHeartVIP.

entities.name: White-Labeling
entities.description: The capability to map a custom domain (iheartvip.com) to a Genuin-powered web experience while presenting a fully branded iHeart UI.

entities.name: Domain Mapping Configuration
entities.description: The engineering configuration that points the iHeartVIP domain to the Genuin web application backend.

entities.name: URL Redirects
entities.description: Mitigation strategy to support both existing iheart.com share URLs and new iheartvip.com URLs to avoid breakage under Approach 1.

entities.name: Approach 1 - Subdomain on Existing iHeart Brand
entities.description: Implementation approach reusing the existing iHeart production brand in BCC and updating its subdomain to iheartvip.begenuin.com.

entities.name: Approach 2 - Separate Brand for iHeartVIP
entities.description: Implementation approach creating a new dedicated iHeartVIP brand inside BCC with its own subdomain for cleaner separation and lower risk.

entities.name: Content Pipeline
entities.description: Existing content pipeline used for iHeart communities; open question whether iHeartVIP will reuse it or source content differently.

entities.name: iHeartVIP iOS App
entities.description: A potential dedicated iOS application for iHeartVIP powered by Genuin, raised as an open question.

entities.name: iHeartVIP Android App
entities.description: A potential dedicated Android application for iHeartVIP powered by Genuin, raised as an open question.

relationships.description: The initiative aims to revive and relaunch the iHeartVIP platform as a modern fan engagement hub.
The revival initiative is targeted at iHeartMedia as the partner brand whose domain and audience will be revived.
Devanshu Shah is the owner of the iHeartVIP Revival Initiative.
Bhargav Patel initiated the requirement for the iHeartVIP Revival Initiative.
Nayan Mevada is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
Nilesh Makwana is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
Krunal Shah is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
Smit Shah is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
Arjav Dave is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
Ankit Gabani is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
Vishal Nirmal is listed as a required stakeholder on the initiative.
iHeartRadio partnered with Concourse Media in 2019 to launch iHeartVIP.com.
iHeartRadio launched iHeartVIP.com in 2019 as a music and industry news destination.
Concourse Media co-launched iHeartVIP.com in partnership with iHeartRadio in 2019.
iHeartMedia owns iHeartVIP and originally deprioritized the publishing initiative before the proposed revival.
iHeartRadio is the iHeart audio brand that operates under iHeartMedia.
The iHeartVIP experience will be powered in the backend by the Genuin web platform via white-labeling.
iHeartVIP will be powered by Genuin's video and community infrastructure to enable communities, clips, and discussions.
The iHeartVIP.com domain will be mapped to the Genuin web platform via white-labeling.
White-labeling is the mechanism that allows the iHeartVIP.com domain to render the Genuin-powered experience.
Domain mapping configuration is the technical step that enables white-labeling of iHeartVIP.com.
The existing iHeartMedia brand instance is managed inside Genuin's BCC.
The proposed iHeartVIP brand instance would be managed inside Genuin's BCC under Approach 2.

relationships.source: Approach 1 - Subdomain on Existing iHeart Brand
relationships.description: Approach 1 reuses the existing iHeart brand instance in BCC and updates its subdomain to iheartvip.begenuin.com.
Approach 2 creates a new dedicated iHeartVIP brand instance in BCC.

relationships.description: Approach 1 depends on implementing URL redirects to mitigate share URL changes between iheart.com and iheartvip.com.
